sources.title: Per-Bank Bandwidth Regulation of Shared Last-Level Cache for Real-Time Systems
sources.snippet: Modern commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) multicore processors have advanced memory hierarchies that enhance memory-level parallelism (MLP), which is crucial for high performance. To support high MLP, shared last-level caches (LLCs) are divided into multiple banks, allowing parallel access.
